relevance_note: TNFAIP3 appears only once, as a group-level count among reanalysis reclassifications ('BRIP1 (n = 1), and TNFAIP3 (n = 1)'), with no individual-level detail (no label, sex, age, variant or phenotype) for that person.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; no script transcribed any table. A text search found exactly one mention of TNFAIP3 and none of A20/HA20. The supplementary material (Figures E1-E2, Online Repository, Tables E1-E4, which may list individual variants) is present only as titles, so no individual-level TNFAIP3 data was available; the other tables are left empty per the instructions. n_patients_reported = 1 is the only TNFAIP3 count the authors give, and it covers only diagnoses added by reanalysis through upward reclassification; the total number of TNFAIP3 diagnoses in the cohort is not stated in the text. cohort_size_as_stated uses the 1505 participants (1000 probands and 505 relatives); 1000 probands would be the alternative denominator. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true because the paper says cohort participants were included in earlier reports on SASH3 (ref 20), NCKAP1L (ref 22) and PIK3CG (ref 23); none of these concerns the TNFAIP3 case. Internal inconsistency found: the paper reports 22 new molecular diagnoses from reanalysis (e.g. '9/22 (40.9%)') but uses 21 as the denominator elsewhere in the same paragraph ('5/21 (23.8%)', '42.9% (9/21)').
